title: It just works
body:
One of the best habit trackers on the store
Yes it lacks some features, but the core stuff just works
Instead other habit trackers try to be fancy but then the core functionality is missing

Also support is excellent, developer fixes bugs pronto
author: yatima1460

title: Simple and extremely functional
body:
An innovative app with extensive customization options. It offers exceptional utility by encouraging users to achieve their goals in an innovative manner. I particularly like the widget functionality and the impressive visual adaptability. I highly recommend using it!
Building good habits and breaking old ones has become a pleasure. Thank you to the developers!
author: ZemljakS

title: Totally recommend
body: User friendly app, it helps me to build positive habits and break bad ones. It provides visual feedback on your progress and makes tracking daily habits a breeze.
author: Sofija*

title: The Habit app
body: I've been using the Habit app without a subscription, and it's been a game-changer for me! The app has helped me develop positive habits and stay on track with my goals. But I recently upgraded to the subscription, and wow, it's taken things to a whole new level! The additional features and resources have made my journey of personal growth even more enjoyable and effective. Highly recommend giving it a try!

title: Habit app

title: PERFECT
body: It’s the perfect app for setting habits. You can set your own goals, reminders and track you habits. It’s also a very cute widget on IOS. And the best part is that it is all for free
